operating_notes.text: Melt N Mellow deep freezer network expanded from 3,732 units to 15,490 units as of March 31, 2026.

₹19.30 Cr of unutilised rights proceeds was held in the ICICI Bank monitoring account (002005050968) at March 31, 2026.

timeline.summary: Krishival Foods expanded its Melt N Mellow ice cream cold chain by deploying 15,490 deep freezers as of March 31, 2026.
Krishival Foods Limited will host a Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call on May 4, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM IST, with Chairman Sujit Bangar, CEO Abhishek Puranik, and CEO Nana Mhaske.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹102.07 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹5.44 Cr.
Krishival Foods submitted its statement of non-deviation for ₹34.99 Cr raised via rights issue for FY26.

Krishival Foods filed a revised first monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, correcting capex utilisation to ₹5.76 Cr from ₹5.80 Cr; ₹34.99 Cr of the ₹99.99 Cr rights issue had been received.
Krishival Foods Limited held Q4 FY26 Earnings Conference Call on May 4, 2026, at 5:30 PM IST with audio recording available via link.
Krishival Foods Limited held Q4 FY26 Earnings Conference Call on May 4, 2026, at 5:30 PM IST with **Suresh Gawande** and **Rahul Gawande** via virtual mode.
Krishival Foods held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 4, 2026, reporting 48% YoY revenue growth to ₹304.41 Cr.
Krishival Foods reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹88.96 Cr, up 80% YoY, with Melt N Mellow ice cream segment revenue at ₹51.57 Cr, achieving EBITDA profitability ahead of plan.
Krishival Foods converted 5,51,289 partly paid shares after receiving ₹10.75 crore in final call proceeds.
